idea-plugin.name: Rise Codex Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Rise / Codex — a dark, disciplined IDE theme. Aged iron, oxidized brass, parchment, candlelight and sealing wax; warm luminance hierarchy, no blue accents, red reserved for errors.

UI theme for the Islands look plus a matching editor colour scheme (C#, HLSL/ShaderLab, JSON, YAML, XML, Markdown, terminal palette).

IN CODEX VERITAS
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.4 — back to the solid ember fill for errors (the rounded box of 1.0.3 was too faint).

1.0.3 — errors drawn as a rounded ember box around the word.

1.0.2 — errors highlight the whole word on an ember background instead of a wavy underline.

1.0.1 — text tokens lifted halfway (lighter, slightly more saturated), inactive islands less dimmed, new-UI checkbox palette keys.

1.0.0 — initial release.
